jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished square inventory item icon for the Korean fantasy MMORPG LAQIA, Blue Moon Twilight greatsword. Reference 1 is the native Black Knight icon: match its simple straight square gold border and black background, economical readable item sprite composition. Reference 2 is the exact sword identity. Make a crisp painted/prerendered game item icon with broad readable blue steel and pale silver blade surfaces, subtle gold fittings, the flowing S-curved blade and small crescent guard of reference 2. Diagonal composition, blade pointing toward lower-left and grip toward upper-right, show recognizable connected blade, crescent guard and grip. Fill the square confidently with the weapon, not an ornamental medallion closeup. The sword must read at tiny inventory size. Thin uninterrupted antique gold double-bevel SQUARE border flush along all four outside edges, straight sharp corners, simple and uniform, about 1/28 of canvas width per line, no ornate corners. Pure black inside background. Deep cobalt and moonlit silver weapon, restrained ice-blue jewel. Simplify fine filigree, retain large material planes. No lettering, numbers, watermark, label, hands, scenic background, sparkles, fog, or huge glow. Output a single square icon, no sheet, no surrounding margin.
